svg.title: Three tests of a stewardship arrangement
svg.desc: Transfer competence: Another qualified participant can understand the work and its evidence.. Correct institutions: A mistake can be acknowledged, challenged and repaired.. Cooperate independently: Different stewards can coordinate within explicit scopes.. Evidence of these capabilities must accompany the principle. A commitment alone does not demonstrate replaceability.

g.text: Three tests of a stewardship arrangement
Another qualified participant can understand the work and its evidence.
A mistake can be acknowledged, challenged and repaired.
Different stewards can coordinate within explicit scopes.
Evidence of these capabilities must accompany the principle. A commitment
